title: Pokémon Ultra Moon
tested: The base game (v1.0, no update): new game in German from the language screen through Kukui's call, the name entry, the opening cutscenes and the title logo to the bedroom; walking there, the X menu, saving with Y, and after a restart Continue from that save. Not tested: anything after the bedroom (no battle), long sessions. Seen on Linux with software Vulkan (llvmpipe in WSL2) only: the title screen's animation stays white, then black, before the Continue menu's result (the bedroom) shows correctly; on Windows with a real GPU the title is right. On Windows the same route was also played with the v1.2 update (recompiled with `--mods`), which these scripts do not set up. 19 Nov 2026, on the mini PC (Ryzen 3 PRO 4350GE, Radeon Vega 6): hitches measured per picture and three causes fixed in the local patch - pipelines linked at once when their parts exist and remade in the background from a list of the runs before, one worker thread kept for the quick fragment-shader pipelines, the CPU shading a draw until its vertex shader is compiled on integrated GPUs - and the game file read from an SSD instead of a pooled hard disk (each read through the pool cost 8-40 ms and stopped picture and sound). Test routes afterwards: no sound gap, 0-2 late pictures inside a scene. Still open: a scene the game reads back from the GPU every picture runs at 20 pictures a second for a second or two; a scene seen for the very first time can drop to 13-19 pictures a second while the driver compiles its vertex shaders (15-38 s each, once).
